Method of Attack: Brute-force attack to gain access to MySQL servers, encrypting databases, and dropping ransom notes in a 'Warning' table
Hacking into insecure servers reachable over the public web, copying SQL databases, and demanding ransom for stolen data
Impacted Systems: E-commerce platforms including Shopware, JTL-Shop, PrestaShop, OpenCart, Magento v1 and v2
Attack Vector: Exploitation of insecure servers accessible via the public web
Indicators of Compromise: Public website offering stolen SQL databases for sale
Ransom notes demanding BTC 0.06 (~$525) within 10 days
Bitcoin wallets with over 100 transactions totaling BTC 5.8 (~$51,000)
Abuse reports dating from September 20, 2019 to May 20, 2020
Databases with sample data dumps from 2016 to 2020
